description.description: These frames show a fan-made modification of Super Mario 64 with a North Korean theme called 'Super North Korea 64.' The first frame is the title screen, featuring a stylized logo with North Korean flags inside the letters and a floating head of Mario wearing a military cap with a red star. The second frame depicts Mario in a level called 'The People's Square,' collecting a 'Hero Star.' The third frame shows Mario running through a large square with red flags and a Goomba wearing a military hat, with a government-style building in the background featuring a portrait. The final frame shows Mario jumping in a level filled with rows of North Korean flags.
